claims.claim: FINALIZE_CANDIDATE admission selects the nearest valid structural package within the contiguous same-head lineage and stops selection at a predecessor head change.
Eligible reuse supplies the structural ResultPackage through the existing continuation RUN and REPAIR path, bypassing Executor invocation while retaining unchanged-head completion gates.
Reusable packages require empty package and claim evidence; completion retains Runtime verification and Runtime evidence attachment.
Historical admission retains canonical transported failure artifacts across the continuation chain and selects source structure from those artifacts without substituting local cache state.

Present reusable state is checked before continuation execution for structural validity, TASK and head bindings, lineage consistency, Git changed-files authority, scope, unresolved items, acceptance coverage, evidence emptiness, and local/canonical conflicts.
NO_CHANGE retains direct-source reuse; mutation actions bypass ancestor selection; FINALIZE_CANDIDATE retains its Executor path when selection finds no package.

Regression coverage includes complete structure followed by two same-head completion-gate failures, fresh-checkout historical recovery, nearest-source selection, action isolation, and the required invalid-package and head-change cases.
